sourceTitle: Western Himalaya and Tibet A Narrative of a Journey Through the Mountains of Northern India During the Years 1847-8
description: "Western Himalaya and Tibet" by Thomas Thomson is a narrative account of a journey through the mountainous regions of Northern India written in the mid-19th century. This expedition aimed to explore the geography, flora, and climate of the Western Himalayas and Tibet, reflecting scientific interests of the time.
